title: Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar

descriptions.short: Seek the eight virtues and become the Avatar in a landmark role-playing game.
descriptions.long: Return to Britannia through the open-source xu4 engine with modern web and touch interfaces, protected local saves, portable backups, maps, journals, and optional private synchronization.

acquisition.guidance: Provide a complete supported English DOS/EGA copy. Files are validated locally and are not uploaded merely to play.

knownLimitations: The public web release requires a supported original DOS/EGA data set.
Voice input and shared controller remapping are not yet available.
